title: i72x.6.a: reference_schnorr48 upstream AddrForKey + regenerate root_dio_signature.json
description: Child of i72x.6 step 3 (root_dio_signature corpus only). (2) Regenerate test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json via test/vectors/generate_root_dio_signature.py (same seeds/fields; dodag_id=AddrForKey; re-sign; expected anchor for root seed 000102..*4: 020030ad221f03322adb901f8b731688 per C test main.c:39 comment — verify independently). (3) Verify Python root-dio corpus tests stay green; run pytest on affected dirs. Do NOT touch other corpora (separate beads).
